select ctr.refund_id, ctr.transaction_id, ctr.refund_number, ctr.refund_date, ctr.refund_amount, ctr.bank_account_id, ctr.bank_slip_num, ctr.bp_bank_account_id, ctr.payment_method, ( SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'CSH.PAYMENT_METHOD' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = ctr.payment_method ) payment_method_n, ctr.bp_id, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = ctr.bp_id ) as bp_name, (select cba.bank_account_num from csh_bank_account cba where cba.bank_account_id = ctr.bank_account_id) bank_account_num, (select cba.bank_account_name from csh_bank_account cba where cba.bank_account_id = ctr.bank_account_id) bank_account_name, ctr.bp_bank_account_num bp_bank_account_num, ctr.bp_bank_account_name bp_bank_account_name, ctr.bp_bank_name bp_bank_name, ctr.bp_bank_branch_name bp_bank_branch_name from csh_transaction_refund ctr
and ctr.REFUND_ID=#{refundId}

select ctr.refund_id, ctr.transaction_id, ctr.refund_number, ctr.refund_date, ctr.refund_amount, ctr.refund_status, ctr.bank_account_id, ctr.period_number, ctr.currency_code, ctr.bank_slip_num, ctr.bp_bank_account_id, ctr.process_instance_id, ctr.object_version_number, ctr.request_id, ctr.program_id, ctr.created_by, ctr.creation_date, ctr.last_updated_by, ctr.last_update_date, ctr.last_update_login, ctr.description, ctr.refund_flag, ctr.handling_department_id, ctr.handling_department, ctr.financial_agent, ctr.financial_agent_id, ctr.payment_description, ctr.payment_process_instance_id, ctr.payment_refund_status, ctr.actual_payment_date, ctr.payment_method, ( SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'CSH.PAYMENT_METHOD' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = ctr.payment_method ) payment_method_n, ctr.bp_id, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = ctr.bp_id ) as bp_name, (select cba.bank_account_num from csh_bank_account cba where cba.bank_account_id = ctr.bank_account_id) bank_account_num, (select cba.bank_account_name from csh_bank_account cba where cba.bank_account_id = ctr.bank_account_id) bank_account_name, (select hba.bank_account_num from hls_bp_master_bank_account hba where hba.bank_account_id = ctr.bp_bank_account_id) bp_bank_account_num, (select hba.bank_account_name from hls_bp_master_bank_account hba where hba.bank_account_id = ctr.bp_bank_account_id) bp_bank_account_name, (select hba.bank_full_name from hls_bp_master_bank_account hba where hba.bank_account_id = ctr.bp_bank_account_id) bp_bank_name, (select hba.bank_branch_name from hls_bp_master_bank_account hba where hba.bank_account_id = ctr.bp_bank_account_id) bp_bank_branch_name, ctr.authority_rule_string from csh_transaction_refund ctr
and ctr.REFUND_ID=#{refundId}

select caa.cashflow_id, ctrl.refund_amount from CSH_TRANSACTION_REFUND ctr LEFT JOIN CSH_TRANSACTION_REFUND_LN ctrl ON ctrl.REFUND_ID = ctr.REFUND_ID LEFT JOIN CSH_TRANSACTION ct ON ct.TRANSACTION_ID = ctrl.SOURCE_TRANSACTION_ID LEFT JOIN csh_allocation_receipt car ON car.transaction_id = ct.SOURCE_TRANSACTION_ID LEFT JOIN CSH_ALLOCATION_ADVANCE caa ON caa.ALLOCATION_ID = car.ALLOCATION_ID where ctr.REFUND_ID = #{refundId}
